title: Old Fashioned Russian Chuck Roast Stew
description: A hearty, lacto-vegetarian-friendly stew featuring slow-cooked chuck roast, perfect for a hangover cure or a comforting meal. The long cooking time breaks down the connective tissues in the meat, making it tender and jammy.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are softened and lightly browned.
Add the cubed chuck roast and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the chopped carrots, potatoes, and sliced mushrooms, and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the beef broth, and add the dried thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Cover the Dutch oven and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Stir in the sour cream and continue to cook for an additional 30 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
